contexts.text: The number seventeen = both the beginning and the end of temptation, because it is composed of seven and ten. Explained, Illustrated.
The seventeenth day () = what is new.
A son of seventeen years () = it state.

Seventeen = a beginning; here, the beginning of the representation by Joseph. It = a beginning and what is new; and moreover involves in general... all things represented by Joseph; for seven = what is holy; and ten = remains.

Seventeen years () = the state there; for seventeen = from the beginning to the end, or from the beginning to what is new. Thus the seventeen years in which Jacob lived in Egypt = the beginning of the state of spiritual life in the Natural among scientifics even to its end.
